svg.title: A nurse is teaching a client with reduced vision about home safety. Which of the following should the nurse include?
svg.desc: Clear paths, good lighting, high-contrast step edges, and predictable placement of belongings all let a client with low vision move safely using memory and contrast. Rearranging furniture destroys the mental map the client relies on, and dim lighting reduces the little usable vision that remains.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Vision Home Safety
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching a client with reduced
vision about home safety. Which of the
following should the nurse include?
What fits here
Remove throw rugs and keep walkways clear
· Add lighting to stairways and check that
the handrails are secure · Mark the edge
of each step with a strongly contrasting
color · Keep…
Why it fits
Clear paths, good lighting, high-contrast
step edges, and predictable placement of
belongings all let a client with low
vision move safely using memory and
contrast. Rearranging furniture destroys
the mental map the client relies on, and
dim lighting reduces the little usable
vision that remains.
